title: Flying with the Ink Spots and Louis Jordan; Dottie Smith
summary: They flew or took trains, driving only when in a hurry; Jordan got good work and Dottie Smith settled in Philadelphia.

bands.name: Louis Jordan and His Tympany Five

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: But I guess you used to travel a lot by bus?
And Louis Jourdan. Did you fly with Louis Jourdan?
Yeah. Yeah, he never -- the only time we drove was when we were back east somewhere.
And we was in a hurry to get there, so we'd leave in a certain part of the night and by that next morning we'd be pulling in, 9:00, 10:00 o'clock in the morning.
We'd be pulling in. And we'd get a room.
Well, he you used to play pretty big rooms, right?
Like big rooms in major cities.
Not so much like staying in one area and working small rooms.
Louis got us That was good work. He's passed too, you know.
Dottie Smith. She lives in Philly.
Do you think she's back there now?
I imagine so. She got married.
